```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../../../../../core/framework/R/framework_init.R")
```

```{r load-gazetteer-data, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON("russian_civil_war_settlements.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
sum_json <- jsonlite::fromJSON((if (file.exists("russian_civil_war_summary.json")) "russian_civil_war_summary.json" else "../../_shared/_gis_cache/russian_civil_war_summary.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)

all_entries <- unname(gaz_map)
regs <- sum_json$regions
reg_ids <- vapply(regs, function (r) as.character(r$id), character(1))
reg_num_map <- setNames(seq_along(reg_ids), reg_ids)

fmt_eu_pop <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)), "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(as.integer(k), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function (arg0_x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(arg0_x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  return(gsub("\\.", ",", s))
}

get_p <- function (arg0_e, arg1_yr) {
  v <- arg0_e$population[[arg1_yr]]
  if (is.null(v)) return(NA_real_)
  return(as.numeric(v))
}

build_reg48_df <- function (arg0_reg_nums) {
  target_ids <- reg_ids[arg0_reg_nums]
  sub_entries <- Filter(function (e) as.character(e$region_id) %in% target_ids, all_entries)
  rows <- lapply(sub_entries, function (e) {
    rnum <- reg_num_map[[as.character(e$region_id)]]
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    oth_part <- if (length(raw_oth) > 0) paste0(" [", raw_oth[1], "]") else ""
    coord_str <- paste0(fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), "N, ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]), "E")
    data.frame(
      `Settlement (Reg.)` = paste0(e$name, oth_part, " (R", rnum, ")"),
      `Coords` = coord_str,
      `1914` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1914")),
      `1917` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1917")),
      `1918` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1918")),
      `1919` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1919")),
      `1920` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1920")),
      `1921` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1921")),
      `1922` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1922")),
      `1924` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1924")),
      `1926` = fmt_eu_pop(get_p(e, "1926")),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, rows))
}

GAZ_COL_FRACS <- c(0.245, 0.115, rep(0.0545, 9))
```

# Overview and Forty-Eight-Region Tsarist Gazetteer Structure

This supplementary settlement gazetteer compiles 275 urban centres, governorate and uezd seats, seceding national capitals, early Soviet autonomous republic (ASSR) and autonomous oblast (AO) capitals, industrial towns and Arctic river posts across all forty-eight pre-war Tsarist Governorates and Oblasts (18 607 231 km2) from the 1914AD pre-war baseline through the 1917AD Revolutions, the 1918-1922AD Civil War and Independence Wars, the 1921-1922AD Povolzhye-Ural-Southern Ukrainian Famine and the 1926AD recovery. Every catalogued settlement is mapped to one of the forty-eight historical regions alongside positive integer population benchmarks across all nine epoch years: 1914AD, 1917AD, 1918AD, 1919AD, 1920AD, 1921AD, 1922AD, 1924AD and 1926AD.

Municipal series are anchored to the 1914AD TsSK statistical yearbooks, the 1917AD All-Russian Municipal Census [@vseros1917gorod], the 28 August 1920AD All-Russian Census [@tsu1920perepis], the 1920AD Finnish Census [@svt1923finland], the 1920AD and 1925AD Latvian Censuses [@skujenieks1927latvia], the 30 September 1921AD First Polish Census [@gus1921skorowidz; @barwinski2015ethnic], the 15 February 1921AD Czechoslovak Census [@csr1924scitani], the 28 December 1922AD Estonian Census [@estonia1924rahvaloendus], the 17 September 1923AD Lithuanian Census [@lithuania1926gyventojai], Romanian administrative directories for Bessarabia and Bukovina [@tartakovsky2009bessarabia; @fondos2024bessarabia], the 15 March 1923AD All-Union Urban Census [@tsu1923gorod] and the 17 December 1926AD First All-Union Population Census [@tsu1926vsesoyuznaya; @koenker1985urbanization; @volkov1930dinamika].

# Regions 1 - 4: Former Congress Poland (Ten Vistula Governorates)

Table \ref{tab:reg1-4} documents 23 industrial and administrative centres across Warsaw, Plock and Lomza (Region 1), Piotrkow and Kalisz (Region 2), Lublin, Siedlce and Kholm (Region 3) and Radom, Kielce and Suwalki (Region 4), capturing the 1914AD shelling of Kalisz, the 1915AD Great Retreat evacuation, raw-material blockade de-industrialisation in Lodz (477,9k to 342,0k in 1917AD), the 1920AD Battle of Warsaw and post-Riga urban recovery in the 1921AD Polish Census [@gus1921skorowidz; @barwinski2015ethnic; @gatrell1999whole].

```{r table-reg1-4, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
render_table_template(
  build_reg48_df(1:4),
  list(
    caption = "Settlements of Regions 1 - 4: Former Congress Poland / Vistula Governorates (1914AD - 1926AD).",
    label = "tab:reg1-4",
    col_fracs = GAZ_COL_FRACS
  )
)
```

# Regions 10 - 16: Lithuania, Belarus, Galicia, Bukovina-Subcarpathia and Bessarabia

# Regions 41 - 48: West and East Siberia, Altai-Tuva, Yakutia and the Far East

Table \ref{tab:reg41-48} compiles 41 towns across Southern Tobolsk and Omsk (Region 41), the Northern Ob-Irtysh Tundra (Region 42), Tomsk and Altai (Region 43), Altai-Sayan and Uriankhai/Tuva (Region 44), Krasnoyarsk and Irkutsk (Region 45), Yenisei-Turukhansk and Lena Goldfields (Region 46), Transbaikalia and Yakutia (Region 47) and Priamurye and Sakhalin (Region 48), tracing Kolchak's 1919AD refugee swell in Omsk (245k), the 1919-1920AD Great Siberian Ice March typhus trail, Chita as capital of the Far Eastern Republic (1920-1922AD), the May 1920AD destruction of Nikolaevsk-on-Amur and the October 1922AD evacuation of Vladivostok [@smele2015russian; @borodin2012siberia; @tumurkhonova2009buryat; @temirgaleev2017primorye].

# Forty-Eight-Region Gazetteer Coverage and Urban-Regional Summary

Table \ref{tab:reg48-summary} verifies 100% regional coverage across all forty-eight pre-war Tsarist Governorates and Oblasts (275 settlements in total, with at least four settlements in every region), comparing total regional populations (k) against gazetteer municipal sums (k) at 1914AD, 1917AD, 1920AD, 1922AD and 1926AD.

```{r table-reg48-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
fmt_int_sp <- function (v) format(as.integer(round(v)), big.mark = " ", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(regs), function (i) {
  r <- regs[[i]]
  rid <- as.character(r$id)
  sub_e <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(e$region_id), rid), all_entries)
  n_c <- length(sub_e)
  u14 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1914"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  u20 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1920"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  u26 <- sum(vapply(sub_e, function (e) get_p(e, "1926"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
  short_nm <- trimws(strsplit(strsplit(as.character(r$name), "\\(")[[1]][1], ":")[[1]][1])
  data.frame(
    `Region (Tsarist Governorate / Oblast)` = short_nm,
    `Cities` = as.character(n_c),
    `Reg 1914` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(r$population_k[["1914"]]), "k"),
    `Reg 1917` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(r$population_k[["1917"]]), "k"),
    `Reg 1922` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(r$population_k[["1922"]]), "k"),
    `Reg 1926` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(r$population_k[["1926"]]), "k"),
    `Urb 1914` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(u14), "k"),
    `Urb 1920` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(u20), "k"),
    `Urb 1926` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(u26), "k"),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

tot_u14 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1914"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
tot_u20 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1920"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0
tot_u26 <- sum(vapply(all_entries, function (e) get_p(e, "1926"), numeric(1))) / 1000.0

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Tsarist Governorate / Oblast)` = "Total (All 48 Tsarist Regions)",
  `Cities` = as.character(length(all_entries)),
  `Reg 1914` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1914"]]), "k"),
  `Reg 1917` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1917"]]), "k"),
  `Reg 1922` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1922"]]), "k"),
  `Reg 1926` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(sum_json$totals_k_by_year[["1926"]]), "k"),
  `Urb 1914` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(tot_u14), "k"),
  `Urb 1920` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(tot_u20), "k"),
  `Urb 1926` = paste0(fmt_int_sp(tot_u26), "k"),
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

render_table_template(
  rbind(do.call(rbind, sum_rows), tot_row),
  list(
    caption = "Summary of Regional Totals and Gazetteer Urban Sums Across All Forty-Eight Tsarist Regions (1914AD - 1926AD).",
    label = "tab:reg48-summary",
    col_fracs = c(0.295, 0.055, rep(0.072, 7))
  )
)
```
